# Ahem test font fixture

`Ahem.ttf` is copied unchanged from the
[Text fixture](../../../../../surgeist-text/tests/fixtures/fonts/ahem/PROVENANCE.md),
which records the upstream source, <https://www.w3.org/Style/CSS/Test/Fonts/Ahem/>,
and the probe of its metrics and glyphs. Layout tests include these bytes so that
the crate reads no file outside its own directory.

SHA-256: `f0a92cd0cc45735591c9b5b1fa8aecd5194e8dc518895ca22af94a46c23550dc`.

License: public domain with Creative Commons Zero fallback, as stated in the
[declaration](../../../../licenses/ahem/COPYING). The
[upstream README](../../../../licenses/ahem/UPSTREAM-README) retains authorship
and usage information. The font is a test resource, with no transformation or new
acquisition.
